# 0.1.0 mailbox fixture

`agent-comms.sqlite` is a mailbox written by the 0.1.0 release code. It is kept
as evidence for importing or refusing 0.1.0 mailboxes.

- Generated by `generate.py` in this directory, using the `agent_comms` package
  at commit `250f3ef` (package version 0.1.0).
- Regenerate from a checkout of that commit:

  ```sh
  python3 tests/fixtures/v0_1_0/generate.py NEW.sqlite
  ```

  `NEW.sqlite` must not exist. Timestamps and ids are pinned, so the schema
  and rows match the committed file. With the same SQLite build the file is
  byte-identical; other builds may differ in header bytes such as the writer's
  library version.
- The 0.1.0 store runs in WAL mode. The script checkpoints the WAL and switches
  the file to rollback-journal mode, so all rows are in this one file. The
  schema and rows are exactly what 0.1.0 wrote.

## Contents

| Table | Rows | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `agents` | 4 | two teams (`team-a`, `team-b`); architect, worker, reviewer roles; fictional roots under `/srv/` |
| `messages` | 5 | priorities `low`, `normal`, `high`, `blocker`; `requires_ack` on and off; two with file refs |
| `message_recipients` | 6 | statuses `sent`, `read`, `acknowledged` (with response), `closed` (with and without response); one multi-recipient message |
| `message_threads` | 5 | one reply linked to its parent |
| `statuses` | 4 | two rows for one agent, with `blocked_on` and `next_step` set |

`tests/substrate/test_v0_1_0_fixture.py` checks that the file opens read-only and has
these rows.
